items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out for Week 6 vs Jaguars; Pitre also out.
items.why: Groin injury; no travel confirmed by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Woody Marks expected workhorse role (98% snaps prior); RB2/FLEX despite tough JAC run D.
items.opportunity: Full backfield snaps/carries/red-zone for Marks handcuff.

items.text: Jalen Hurts is out for Week 6 (and indefinitely until medical situation resolved) after follow-up ultrasound showed movement in a superficial blood clot in his calf; Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot moved; treatment course (likely blood thinners) TBD; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts vs CAR; Eagles pass game/rushing TDs shift; Hurts multi-week risk.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume; potential WR/TE target concentration without Hurts mobility.

items.text: For the second straight day, Bills WR DJ Moore did not practice due to his shoulder injury.
items.implication: Questionable/out risk vs LV; other Bills WRs elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining BUF receivers.

items.text: No practice again for Saquon Barkley; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice. Eagles injury report Thursday.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or limited; Smith progress but Q; Hurts already out compounds Eagles issues.
items.opportunity: Gainwell or other backs if Barkley sits; WRs if Smith limited.

items.text: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee), RB David Montgomery (groin) and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel and are ruled out vs Jaguars in London.
items.why: Injuries; no travel for London game.
items.implication: Nico Collins and other Texans WRs elevated targets; Marks RB lead.
items.opportunity: Increased target share for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again today due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Q or out risk; Worthy/Kelce targets up if sits.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again today (ankle).
items.why: Ankle; consecutive DNPs but realistic chance noted earlier.
items.implication: Game-time decision; rushing limited if plays; Ravens offense impacted.
items.opportunity: If out, backup QB and Likely/Andrews elevated.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; WR4 for Week 6. Season-high 36% target share recently; Deebo out multi-week elevates him further (45%+ targets when Deebo off).
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH; usage spike and depth chart clear with Samuel out.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2 upside; top-5 WR play.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone in favorable spot.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson multi-week out (high ankle). In Week 1 absence Rhamondre Stevenson played 85% snaps/23 touches; >15 touches avg 16.3 PPG since 2024. Stevenson borderline RB1.
items.why: Confirmed multi-week; historical full-workload data for Stevenson.
items.implication: Stevenson locked RB1/2 with volume; start confidently vs NYJ.
items.opportunity: 85%+ snaps, high carries/targets while Henderson sidelined.

items.text: RB snaps in the two full games since Breece Hall's injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Clear hierarchy with Allen dominating snaps post-Hall injury.
items.implication: Allen is the clear lead back/handcuff to roster/start while Hall out.
items.opportunity: Allen near-every-down RB1 usage; high snap/carry share.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return due to shoulder, then returned to the game (TNF).
items.implication: Played through; monitor for lingering but available.
items.conflict: Berry hates Waddle for week due to prior production.

items.text: For the second straight day, Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love did not practice due to an ankle injury.
items.implication: Out risk; other ARI RBs (Allgeier etc.) volume.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz). Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February; Super Bowl contender with RB need should at least call.
items.why: Age curve and Eagles precedent for early exits; risk of year-too-late.
items.implication: Trade value may peak now; long-term dynasty caution despite current production.

items.text: Round 3 rookie Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist surgery) expected back to practice, shot to play weekend. Generated huge camp buzz, elite YPP offense (6.4) even without full Lamar snaps.
items.why: Camp standout with path to big role; high-efficiency BAL offense.
items.implication: Deep league stash/waiver; potential Bateman competition or upside if Lamar limited.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets in elite offense; monitor practice participation.
